subject: Full Science & Math (Board Level)
description: Class 10: Quadratic equations, trigonometry, light & optics, electricity, chemical reactions, acids & bases, and genetics.

questions.subject: Math
questions.questionText: For the quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, what is the discriminant (D) and its condition for having TWO DISTINCT REAL ROOTS?
solutionSteps: The roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 are given by x = (-b ± √D) / (2a).
The discriminant is D = b² - 4ac.
If D > 0, the square root is real and non-zero, producing two distinct real roots.
(If D = 0 roots are equal; if D < 0 roots are imaginary).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: According to Ohm's Law, at constant temperature, the current (I) flowing through a conductor is directly proportional to potential difference (V). What is the formula?
solutionSteps: Ohm's Law states: V ∝ I.
Introducing the constant of proportionality R (Resistance):
V = I × R (Voltage = Current × Resistance).
Standard formula: V = IR.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: What type of chemical reaction is represented by: 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO?
solutionSteps: Two separate reactants (Magnesium metal and Oxygen gas) react together.
They combine into a single chemical product (Magnesium oxide, MgO).
Reactions where two or more reactants combine into one single product are Combination Reactions.
questions.hint: Two elements combine to form a single compound.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.questionText: What is the structural and functional microscopic filtration unit of the human kidney?
solutionSteps: Neurons are the structural units of the nervous system.
Alveoli are units of respiratory gas exchange in the lungs.
Each kidney contains approximately 1 million Nephrons, which filter blood through Bowman's capsules and tubules to form urine.

questions.subject: Math
questions.questionText: Which of the following is a fundamental Pythagorean trigonometric identity for any acute angle θ?
solutionSteps: From a right triangle with sides a (opposite), b (adjacent), and c (hypotenuse): a² + b² = c².
Divide by c²: (a/c)² + (b/c)² = 1.
Since sinθ = a/c and cosθ = b/c:
sin²θ + cos²θ = 1.
questions.hint: Sine squared plus cosine squared equals one.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: What is the Lens Formula relating focal length (f), image distance (v), and object distance (u)?
solutionSteps: For spherical mirrors, the mirror formula is 1/f = 1/v + 1/u.
For thin optical lenses, refraction reverses the sign:
Correct lens formula: 1/f = 1/v - 1/u.
questions.hint: Minus sign between 1/v and 1/u for lenses.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: Carbon forms millions of organic compounds due to its unique ability to form strong covalent bonds with other carbon atoms. This property is called:
solutionSteps: Carbon has a valency of 4 (tetravalency) and a very small atomic size, creating exceptionally strong C-C covalent bonds.
The self-linking capability of carbon atoms into long chains, branched networks, and rings is called Catenation.
questions.hint: Self-linking of atoms into long chains = Catenation.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.questionText: In Gregor Mendel's monohybrid cross of pure tall (TT) and pure dwarf (tt) pea plants, what is the PHENOTYPIC ratio in the F2 generation?
solutionSteps: F1 generation offspring are all heterozygous tall (Tt).
Self-crossing F1 (Tt × Tt) gives genotypes: 1 TT : 2 Tt : 1 tt.
Phenotypically, TT and Tt are tall (3 parts), while tt is dwarf (1 part).
Phenotypic ratio = 3 : 1.

questions.subject: Math
questions.questionText: What is the exact value of tan 45°?
solutionSteps: In a 45°-45°-90° right isosceles triangle, both legs are equal in length (opposite = adjacent).
tan 45° = opposite / adjacent = x / x = 1.
Therefore, tan 45° = 1.
questions.hint: Opposite and adjacent sides are equal at 45 degrees.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: Two resistors of 6 Ω and 3 Ω are connected in PARALLEL. What is their equivalent resistance (R_eq)?
solutionSteps: Parallel resistance formula: 1/R_eq = 1/R1 + 1/R2.
Taking the reciprocal: R_eq = 2 Ω.
Equivalent parallel resistance = 2 Ω.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: What is the chemical formula of Plaster of Paris (POP)?
solutionSteps: Gypsum is Calcium sulphate dihydrate: CaSO₄ · 2H₂O.
When gypsum is carefully heated to 373 K (100°C), it loses three-fourths of its crystallization water.
It forms Calcium sulphate hemihydrate: CaSO₄ · ½H₂O (Plaster of Paris).
questions.hint: Calcium sulphate hemihydrate (half water molecule per CaSO4).

questions.subject: Biology
questions.questionText: Which plant hormone promotes cell elongation, apical dominance, and causes phototropic bending towards sunlight?
solutionSteps: Auxin is synthesized at shoot tips.
When light comes from one direction, auxin diffuses to the shaded side of the shoot.
Higher auxin concentration stimulates cells on the shaded side to grow longer, bending the shoot toward light.
Hormone = Auxin.
questions.hint: Synthesized at shoot tips for elongation.

questions.subject: Math
questions.questionText: In an Arithmetic Progression (AP) with first term a = 3 and common difference d = 4, what is the 10th term (a₁₀)?
solutionSteps: General formula for the nth term of an AP: aₙ = a + (n - 1)d.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: Which rule predicts the direction of force experienced by a current-carrying conductor placed inside a magnetic field?
solutionSteps: Fleming's Left-Hand Rule is used for electric motors:
Thumb points to Force (Motion), Forefinger points to Magnetic Field, and Middle finger points to Current.
(Right-Hand rule is for induced current in generators).
Correct rule: Fleming's Left-Hand Rule.
questions.hint: Left hand for motors/force, right hand for generators/induced current.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: What happens when an iron nail is dipped into a blue copper sulphate (CuSO₄) solution?
options: Iron displaces copper, turning solution green and depositing reddish-brown copper on the nail
The solution turns deep purple with gas bubbling
The nail completely dissolves in seconds
solutionSteps: Iron is more reactive than Copper in the metal reactivity series.
Fe + CuSO₄ → FeSO₄ + Cu.
Blue copper sulphate transforms into pale green ferrous sulphate (FeSO₄).
Reddish-brown copper metal plates out onto the iron nail.
questions.hint: Single displacement reaction: Iron kicks out copper.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.questionText: During intense strenuous exercise, muscle cells experience oxygen deficiency and break down pyruvate anaerobically into:
solutionSteps: In high-intensity sprinting, oxygen delivery to muscles cannot meet cellular energy demands.
Pyruvate is converted via anaerobic glycolysis into 3-carbon Lactic Acid.
Accumulation of lactic acid in muscle fibers causes fatigue and muscle cramps.
questions.hint: Lactic acid accumulation causes muscle cramps.

questions.subject: Math
questions.questionText: How many tangents can be drawn to a circle from a single point lying OUTSIDE the circle?
solutionSteps: From an external point P outside a circle with center O,
Two straight lines can be drawn that touch the circle at exactly one point each (tangency points A and B).
Moreover, both tangent segments PA and PB are equal in length.
Exactly 2 tangents.
questions.hint: From an external point, exactly two tangents touch the circle.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: Myopia (near-sightedness), where distant objects appear blurry, is corrected using which optical lens?
solutionSteps: In a myopic eye, rays from distant objects converge in front of the retina.
A diverging Concave Lens spreads the incoming parallel rays slightly outward.
This pushes the focal convergence point backward directly onto the retinal screen.
Corrective lens = Concave lens.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: A solution turns universal indicator purple and has a pH of 13. This solution is:
solutionSteps: The pH scale ranges from 0 to 14.
pH 7 is neutral (pure water).
pH 0 to 6 is acidic (lower is stronger).
pH 8 to 14 is basic/alkaline. pH 13 has very high OH- concentration, so it is Strongly Basic.
questions.hint: pH > 7 is basic; pH 13 is near maximum alkalinity (14).

questions.subject: Biology
questions.questionText: In humans, which combination of sex chromosomes determines a biological MALE offspring?
solutionSteps: Human somatic cells carry 22 pairs of autosomes and 1 pair of sex chromosomes (total 46).
Females have two homologous X chromosomes: XX.
Males have one X chromosome and one Y chromosome: XY.
Offspring inheriting a Y chromosome from the father develops as male (XY).
questions.hint: XX is female, XY is male.
